description: The job role of a IT Infrastructure and Application Associate is typically a support position that assists the Technician or a team of IT professionals. Will give the technical support to end users by programming, responding to their technical inquiries and troubleshooting common hardware and software issues. Also assist with the installation, configuration, maintenance of software applications and give hard ware support viz. assembling and disassembling computer system, replacing components.
awardingBodyName: West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling, Future Skills, Upskilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Identify computer components, set up office package and understand networking concepts.
Describe hardware components and apply security principles to protect systems and networks.
Demonstrate the basic concepts to develop static web pages using HTML and PHP.
Demonstrate programming and database concepts to design, query and optimize databases.
Develop software applications using Visual Basic.
Provide technical support to resolve hardware and software issues.
Write and execute Python programs demonstrating syntax, data types and control structures.
